meta.name: Tiny fast — 8x8 mixed palette
meta.description: Same mixed palette, but on an 8x8 grid. Hypothesis: small grid = immediate chaos, gliders crash on walls within 1-2 turns, placements overlap frequently. Will it feel frantic or broken?
questions: Do gliders reach the opposite wall before the player can think?

Does the game feel fun-frantic or broken-cramped?
